biggest_catch: Election Day runs from before 7am until after the 8pm close with no leaving the polling place — $130-$135 plus $20 for training.
catches: Election-period work only; workers cannot leave the polling place at all on Election Day (before 7am until after the 8pm close).
Pay varies by position: $130-$135 for the day plus $20 for training.
Must be a registered voter of Monroe County (exceptions for 17-year-old high school students).
Cannot be a government official/employee or a candidate on the ballot in that district (except Judge/Inspector).
Judge of Election position filled at municipal elections every 4 years (appointed if not elected).

s6.note: Steps concrete: poll worker application, training, serve Election Day.

steps: Submit the Poll Worker Application via the county Elections page or contact Elections and Voter Registration at (570) 517-3165.
Attend the training provided by the Elections Office ($20 paid for training).
Serve Election Day: report before the 7am opening and remain at the polling place the entire day until after the 8pm close.
timing: Election Day per the county election calendar; training provided before the election.
